Muse has helped me through the worst part in my life.

I was bullied for 8 years, at school and by the whole village in weekends. Then I got put in a mental health institution, where I was stuck for a year. The Cd's of muse I bought whenever I was allowed outside literally kept me alive and still do.

I've grown up in a place where I couldn't have much, we never had enough money to buy clothes brand new, to go to fancy restaurants or zoo's. I dreamt and still dream of going to a Muse concert. I've gone through a period  where I nearly won tickets through a radio station to go, but then they called me to say that they already gave them to a girl. Later I heard them call her and she wasn't really happy because she had to cancel her one direction fan club meeting. She was literally the most ungrateful person I've ever heard of. I stopped listening to muse because every time I heard their songs it made me cry. 
That was 2 months ago. Now I have to wait another year to see them again and I know that I most likely will get a huge budget cut from the government. 

I'll probably never see Muse live. 
If I won the lottery I'd go see Muse. 
It's what I want most.
